Team + Lisa,

Quick reminder ahead of next Monday's submission window (July 29 EOD PT). We're running a short owners-focused hygiene/check call on Monday at 10:00 PT — 20 minutes to sanity-check stages, commit signals, and align on any evidence or clarifications finance will need. Calendar invite going out from RevOps after this thread.

What I need from owners before Monday 9:00 PT:
- Update stage on HubSpot for any deals that moved in the last 7 days (esp. POC -> Contract or Contract -> Legal).
- Add a one-line note on the deal record explaining the primary remaining blocker (pricing, security, exec ok).
- If you expect the deal to commit this quarter, set the commit flag and put a $ value in the ACV field.

Marissa — can you attach the latest workbook and a short agenda? Grace/Jonas — please call out any deals you want prioritized for the call. Lisa — appreciate if you (and Deal Desk) join for a 10-minute sync on any contract/POC questions.

Attachments: weekly-hygiene-playbook.pdf (guidance) — please review page 3 for commit criteria.

Thanks,
Mateo
Head of RevOps
